intro: OwnX builds AI you control. Own1 is a personal AI computer for your home or office. Nexy is its assistant, on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too. OwnX Console runs AI apps on servers you choose, and Earth Compute maps what that computing power costs around the world.

facts.label: Nexy Engine: a single small agent program
ways to run Nexy: Own1, Mac, Windows, Android, cloud, Docker

news.title: Your phone, powered by your other computers
news.text: A phone with no AI model of its own asked for an image, and the Own1 made it using another computer's graphics card. Every result says which device made it.

news.title: Nexy beta for Mac, Windows and Android
news.text: One download page with a step-by-step install guide. All three apps tell you when an update is ready.

news.title: Add a device with an 8-character code
news.text: Your Own1 shows a short code, you type it into Nexy, and you approve the device on the Own1 itself. Guest codes let family or a team use your Own1 within limits you set.

news.title: A new AI agent engine, built small
news.text: Written in Rust as a single 3.5 MB program, it leaves the machine's memory to the AI model. Open source.

news.title: Open your Own1 from anywhere
news.text: The apps reach your Own1 over an encrypted network and sign in with a key only you hold. No router changes needed.

tracks.name: Own1
tracks.summary: A personal AI computer: the AI runs on the Own1, and your data stays on hardware you own.
highlights: AI employees that research, design, write and build, with owner approval before anything is published
Image, music, voice and website studios that run entirely on the Own1
tracks.next: More owner controls over what the assistant does

tracks.name: OwnXOS
tracks.summary: The operating system under every Own1: each app isolated, the whole system reproducible.
highlights: Every app shares the Own1's AI models
Every update is tested on a fresh Own1 before release

tracks.name: OwnX Desktop
tracks.summary: The desktop on every Own1: an app store, studios and AI employees, in owner or demo mode.
highlights: Signed in with a key only the owner holds
Now opens from the Nexy desktop and Android apps, over the private network
tracks.next: One address and one sign-in for every app on the Own1

tracks.name: Nexy
tracks.summary: One assistant for chat, research, projects and routines, the same wherever you run it.
highlights: Runs on Own1, Mac, Windows, Android, Nexy Cloud and Docker
Researches the web and cites its sources
tracks.next: One request built across all your devices at once, shown live

tracks.name: Nexy Engine
tracks.summary: The agent behind Nexy: a new engine in Rust, built to stay out of the AI model's way.
highlights: A single 3.5 MB program
Works with any local AI model server; open source

tracks.name: Nexy for Mac and Windows
tracks.summary: Nexy as a desktop app: on your own computer, in Nexy Cloud, or on your Own1.
highlights: Mac and Windows beta, with automatic updates
Can share its graphics card with your Own1, so your other devices use it
tracks.next: Asking questions about a folder of documents

tracks.name: Nexy for Android and iPhone
tracks.summary: Nexy on your phone, powered by your own Own1 or Nexy Cloud. The phone needs no AI model of its own.
highlights: Android beta: add it to your Own1 with an 8-character code
Images and answers can be made on your own computers, through your Own1

tracks.name: Private network
tracks.summary: An encrypted network joining your devices.
highlights: Built into the Nexy apps, no setup or admin rights needed
Fast, direct connections to your Own1
tracks.next: Your devices sharing AI: a phone using your Own1's GPU

tracks.name: Nexy Cloud
tracks.summary: Nexy hosted for you, for anyone without an Own1 yet.
highlights: A private, isolated space for each user
Full-size models, and every reply says where it ran
tracks.next: Accounts with passkey sign-in, then GPU credits

tracks.name: Earth Compute
tracks.summary: Live index of what compute, AI and infrastructure really cost, with a global map of data centers and an API.
highlights: Price history for GPUs, AI models, storage, RAM and bandwidth in today's dollars
Every data center on a searchable table and 3D map
Prices checked daily against providers' own price lists

tracks.name: OwnX Console
tracks.summary: A console for running AI apps on servers you control, from choosing hardware to a live, one-click deploy.
highlights: One-click deploy with a live step log and a working link at the end
Live compute prices across data center providers beside your own fleet
Builder workspace keeps client apps separate from your own servers
tracks.next: Team accounts with passkeys and roles

tracks.name: OwnX CLI
tracks.summary: A command-line tool for your servers, with live prices from Earth Compute.
highlights: Apps, usage and logs for every server
Finds the lowest-cost compute or AI model, then deploys
tracks.next: More commands as OwnX Console grows

shipped.title: Owner approval for every new device

shipped.title: AI employees that show their work
